text_block_list.text:
Today was the day of the mock races— or so 
it was supposed to be.

A torrential downpour struck, and thunder 
even began to roar.

Left with no choice, everyone had to wait 
inside the gymnasium until the thunder 
subsided.

text_block_list.name: Nervous Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, my jersey is totally soaked...! 
This is the worst...!
(Rumble rumble—CRACK-BOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Timid Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
—Eeeek?! More thunder?! Make it stooop 
already...!!
choice_data_list: (It seems hard to keep their focus...)
(It seems hard to keep their focus...)

text_block_list.text:
Though it was said to be a passing shower, 
it seemed it would take a while to clear. 
While the runners were losing their 
composure—

There was one horse girl who remained 
completely composed. It was Lucky Lilac.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Phew... Next up is—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —Oh, my.

Just then, her squeeze bottle came rolling 
toward me, so I picked it up and handed it 
over to her.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for troubling you. Thank you 
very much.
choice_data_list:
You're remarkably calm despite all this 
commotion.

You're remarkably calm despite all this 
commotion.

text_block_list.text:
I told her that it was impressive how she 
hadn't lost her concentration in the 
middle of all this chaos.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you sure keep a close eye on me, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
In the races ahead, I'm sure there'll be 
much harsher situations than this—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
And to win through that, I believe it's 
vital never to let your focus slip.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking today as good training, too, 
and aim to make full use of it going 
forward.

From the composed way she looked ahead, 
her immense strength of spirit was plain 
to see.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Truly, thank you kindly. Well then, I'll 
get back to my stretches.

After a while, the thunderstorm cleared— 
and the races were set to resume.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...The time for enduring ends here.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
From here on— shall I demonstrate what I'm 
truly capable of?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Haaah—!

While the other horse girls couldn't bring 
out their best, Lucky Lilac tore across 
the track at full power, splendidly 
claiming 1st place—!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Everyone, thank you for your cheers.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
However, my journey is only halfway 
through. From now on, I will make even 
bigger flowers bloom.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—Please continue to look upon me 
favorably.
